column1: # THE USAGE-JOURNAL PRODUCER ROSTER -- the DENOMINATOR, written down.
# Read by scripts/verify_usage_journal_producers.py. One row per producer the
# usage-journal contract declares. The contract is
# HR015 launch/USAGE_JOURNAL_CONTRACT.md, section "WHAT EACH REPO OWES" plus the
# sentence immediately below that table ("The daemon already writes `answering`
# for the chat path.").
# WHY A ROSTER AND NOT ">= 1 ENRICHING RECORD"
# The contract's own gate paragraph asks for "at least one `enriching` record
# and at least one `ingesting` record". That predicate is a GOLDEN CASE: three
# repos owe `enriching`, so one of them writing satisfies it forever while the
# other two are dark. The panel then shows a smaller number, which reads as a
# quiet month rather than a broken pipeline -- the exact silent-failure shape
# the contract says it exists to stop, rebuilt inside its own gate.
# A denominator cannot be inferred from a journal, because a producer that has
# never written is invisible in it. So it is declared here, in a tracked file,
# and the floor on this file's size is pinned separately in
# scripts/usage_journal_producer_floor.tsv. Shrinking the roster to make the
# gate pass therefore takes TWO edits in one change, both visible in review.
# HOW A PRODUCER IS IDENTIFIED IN THE JOURNAL, AND WHAT IS MEASURED VS PINNED
# A record carries no producer field. The only per-producer discriminators
# available are `session_id` and `purpose`, so each row declares which one it
# is matched by:
#   session_prefix   the record's session_id starts with match_value AND its
#                    purpose equals this row's purpose. Both, because a
#                    producer writing the wrong purpose is also a defect.
#   purpose          the record's purpose equals match_value. Used only where
#                    no prefix exists to match on.
# MEASURED, not assumed:
#   cm051_ostler_fda_ingest   PREFIX measured from vendor/ostler_fda/pwg_ingest.py:50
#                             (_USAGE_SESSION_ID = f"ostler-fda-ingest-{uuid4}").
#                             ⚠️ THIS ENTRY USED TO SAY THE WRITER WAS NOT VENDORED, and
#                             that stopped being true when the re-vendor landed (#1305).
#                             Re-measured on the tree that ships: vendor/ostler_fda holds
#                             36 files, 2 of which reference the journal --
#                             usage_journal.py itself, and pwg_ingest.py, which imports
#                             record_usage at :36-37 and calls it at :72.
#                             tests/test_vendored_fda_writes_the_usage_journal.sh proves
#                             it BY EXECUTION ("RUNNING the vendored producer writes a
#                             record"), not by grep.
#                             This correction matters because the old text was a BENIGN
#                             EXPLANATION FOR AN ABSENCE: a reader seeing this probe RED
#                             would have read "fda is dark, expected" and moved on, when
#                             a RED now means something else entirely. That is the same
#                             failure #1141 fixed inside the probe itself.
#   cm044_wiki_compiler       the worked example in the contract's own THE
#                             RECORD section: "cm044-compile-2026-08-24T..."
#   oa_daemon_chat            oa crates/zeroclaw-config/src/cost/tracker.rs:32
#                             session_id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string().
#                             A BARE UUID -- there is no prefix to match on,
#                             which is why this row matches on purpose and the
#                             others do not. Checked before assuming.
# PINNED BY THIS FILE, not yet observable, because the producer is not written:
#   NOBODY. THIS CATEGORY IS EMPTY as of 2026-09-09Z, and it is left in place
#   rather than deleted so the next producer that needs it finds the rule
#   already written down.
#   Both of its former occupants left on the same day, in two changes that
#   crossed: cm048_conversation_extract, whose producer landed upstream as
#   CM048 #78 (merge 53fcdf0b) and reaches the customer as a vendored tree
#   (CM051 #1881); and cm041_identity_resolution, whose producer is upstream
#   CM041 #137 (82f45376) and reaches the customer as CM051-local grafts
#   (CM051 #1884). Each row below now cites the tree that ships it, so both
#   prefixes are MEASURED from shipped code rather than pinned by this file.
#   THE RULE THAT OUTLIVES THEM. A producer named here is one whose prefix this
#   file is guessing. If such a producer lands writing a DIFFERENT session_id
#   prefix, this gate reports it ABSENT and goes RED, and the fix is to correct
#   the row in the same change that wires the producer. That direction is
#   deliberate: a false RED here is one line of review, and a false GREEN is a
#   customer being shown a cost figure that is wrong in the flattering
#   direction.
#   AND WHY EMPTYING IT MATTERS, which is the same reason the
#   cm051_ostler_fda_ingest note above was corrected: while a producer is listed
#   here, a reader who sees this probe RED reads a benign explanation for the
#   absence and stops looking. A RED against either of these two now means
#   something else entirely, and it has an owner.
# status
#   required   must appear in the journal, or the gate FAILS naming it.
#   dormant    declared by the contract but not owed yet, with the contract's
#              own reason quoted in provenance. Reported, never failed on. A
#              dormant producer that DOES appear is a note, not a fault.
# Fields are TAB separated. No field may contain a tab.
# producer_id

column1: cm048_conversation_extract
column7: contract WHAT EACH REPO OWES: conversation fact extraction. THE PREFIX IS NOW MEASURED, NOT PINNED, and this row no longer explains an expected absence: CM048 #78 (merge 53fcdf0b) added _record_model_usage to src/ollama_client.py at the generate and embed call sites, and CM051 vendored it on 2026-09-09Z, so the producer is WIRED. Prefix read from vendor/cm048_pipeline/src/ollama_client.py:43 (_USAGE_RUN_ID = 'cm048-' + a UTC timestamp) and purpose from :42 (_USAGE_PURPOSE = 'enriching'). Proven by running the vendored module, not by grep: the row it wrote was fed to this gate's own adjudicator and moved cm048_conversation_extract from 0 to 1, with the same journal minus that row as the negative control (FAIL, exit 1, naming this producer). WIRED IS NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT, exactly as for cm051_ostler_fda_ingest below: tokens_from_ollama returns (None, None) when the runtime reported no counts and record_usage then writes nothing, and /api/embeddings reports neither by design. So ABSENT on a walk means 'no measured model call happened during conversation extraction', NOT 'the writer is missing'. Two findings, two owners.

column1: cm041_identity_resolution
column7: contract WHAT EACH REPO OWES: identity resolution, where it calls a model. WIRED AS OF CM051 #1884, and this row USED TO SAY THE PRODUCER WAS UNWIRED -- the same stale-benign-explanation shape corrected on cm051_ostler_fda_ingest below, where a reader seeing RED would think 'expected, it is dark' and move on. The producer is upstream CM041 #137 (82f45376) and reaches the customer as CM051-local GRAFTS in the vendored trees, because this repo ships vendored copies pinned BEHIND that commit: vendor/cm041/contact_syncer (six /api/embed sites via contact_syncer/usage.py, session_id cm041-enrich-<utc>) and vendor/cm041/assistant_api/ical-server.py (_embed_text, session_id cm041-api-<utc>). Both match this row's prefix cm041- AND purpose enriching. Proven BY EXECUTION in tests/test_cm041_usage_journal_producer.sh, not by grep. NECESSARY AND NOT SUFFICIENT, same as the fda row: the writer returns without recording when the runtime reports no counts, which is correct and required by the gate's own must-miss arm. So ABSENT here means 'no measured model call happened on this box', NOT 'the writer is missing' -- two different findings with two different owners.

column1: cm051_ostler_fda_ingest
column7: contract WHAT EACH REPO OWES: vendored ostler_fda, per source parse that invokes a model. Prefix measured from vendor/ostler_fda/pwg_ingest.py:50. The writer IS vendored as of #1305 (usage_journal.py present; pwg_ingest imports record_usage at :36-37, calls it at :72) and is proven by execution in tests/test_vendored_fda_writes_the_usage_journal.sh, so the writer is WIRED. That is necessary and NOT sufficient: pwg_ingest.py:64-66 returns early without writing when _tokens_from_ollama yields no counts, which is correct (the gate's own must-miss arm requires it -- an unmeasured response must invent no numbers). So this producer emits only on an ingest that actually made a measured model call. ABSENT here means 'no measured call happened', NOT 'the writer is missing' -- two different findings with two different owners.
